correctness.rationale: A fresh independent finite-field reconstruction from the two defining brackets gives second cohomology dimension 6. Recomputing the induced action of 12 explicit automorphism generators and performing a new breadth-first orbit enumeration over all 15625 classes gives exactly eight orbit sizes 1, 4, 24, 96, 600, 2400, 5000 and 7500. The class-preserving subspace has dimension 1 and its four nonzero classes form one orbit; direct center computation for the split and nonzero class-preserving extensions gives center dimension 3 in both cases. These checks reproduce the headline obstruction.
